integrity: Analytic proof and standalone numerical corroboration, with precise sampling and limiting domains. Classical orthoptic locus not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate Euclidean ellipses; sampling uniform in oriented outward normal angle, not arclength. Inverse identification is restricted to ellipses. Flattening is a limiting family; no degenerate ellipse case.
title: A Poisson-kernel law and exact eccentricity tomography on an ellipse's director circle
